tests.command:
set -eu
image_id="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' jenkins:2.583)"
platform="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}}' jenkins:2.583)"
user="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Config.User}}' jenkins:2.583)"
printf 'image=%s\nplatform=%s\nuser=%s\n' "$image_id" "$platform" "$user"
docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh jenkins:2.583 -c '
  set -eu
  java -version 2>&1
  java -version 2>&1 | grep -F "21.0.12"
  java -version 2>&1 | grep -F "Zero VM"
  git lfs version | grep -F "git-lfs/3.8.0"
  test -f /usr/share/jenkins/jenkins.war
  test -f /opt/jenkins-plugin-manager.jar
  test -f /usr/lib/loongarch64-linux-gnu/libharfbuzz.so.0
  ldd /opt/java/openjdk/lib/libfontmanager.so | grep -F "libharfbuzz.so.0"
'
docker rm -f jenkins2583-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
trap 'docker rm -f jenkins2583-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker run -d --name jenkins2583-smoke   -e JENKINS_JAVA_OPTIONS=-Djenkins.install.runSetupWizard=false   jenkins:2.583 >/dev/null
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  state="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' jenkins2583-smoke)"
  if [ "$state" = "exited" ] || [ "$state" = "dead" ]; then
    docker inspect --format 'status={{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}}' jenkins2583-smoke
    docker logs --tail 240 jenkins2583-smoke
    exit 1
  fi
  code="$(docker exec jenkins2583-smoke curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/ 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$code" in
    2*|3*|4*) ready=1; printf 'http_status=%s after=%ss\n' "$code" "$i"; break ;;
  esac
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then
  docker inspect --format 'status={{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}}' jenkins2583-smoke
  docker logs --tail 240 jenkins2583-smoke
  exit 1
fi
docker logs --tail 80 jenkins2583-smoke

dependencies.name: Jenkins WAR
dependencies.verification: SHA-256, GPG signature, and ZIP integrity

dependencies.name: OpenJDK
dependencies.source: Debian Forky apt package openjdk-21-jdk-headless via USTC

dependencies.name: Git LFS
dependencies.source: Debian Forky apt package git-lfs=3.8.0-1 via USTC

environment_assumptions: Native LoongArch64 Docker daemon; no emulation
Docker legacy builder available; BuildKit is disabled for this recipe
Build context is the Jenkins repository root
Image remains local and is not pushed
applicability.runtime: Jenkins on port 8080 with agent port 50000, running as user jenkins; smoke accepts any HTTP 2xx/3xx/4xx response after startup
